lines.trans: Right, Petukhov, go stand in the corner right now!
Stop misbehaving and bothering the other children.
May I take this pretty toy car?
Of course, Lyosha, take any toy you like!
Play calmly and do not be afraid of anyone.
Thank you very much, I will build a big garage.
And afterwards we will go to have lunch.
Today in the kitchen they cooked delicious soup.
I like hot soup very much!
Eat well so that you grow up strong.
Thank you for your care, Anna Ivanovna!
Well done, Lyosha, you are our best boy.

examples.trans: We have to take all the money.

meanings.note: 'взять на работу' = to give someone a job
'взять на работу' = to give someone a job

examples.text: Вот и возьмите на работу Галилея.

meanings.note: Adjective formed with the common Slavic suffix '-н-' from a noun/verb root. Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('tasty, delicious').

examples.trans: The bread rings are very tasty.

examples.text: Марина Сергеевна, присядьте. Попробуйте чай с сушками, очень вкусные.
examples.trans: Marina Sergeyevna, have a seat. Try the tea with bread rings, they're very tasty.

meanings.note: polite to one person, or to several people

meanings.en: other forms: вас (gen/acc), вам (dat), вами (instr), вас (prep)

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

meanings.note: building or toy parking structure for cars

examples.text: Спасибо большое, я построю большой гараж.
examples.trans: Thank you very much, I will build a big garage.

examples.text: Ты бандитов поймал! Которые банкомат на Гарибальди ограбили.
examples.trans: You caught bandits! Who robbed the ATM on Garibaldi Street.

meanings.en: hot (to the touch, of food/drink, not weather)
meanings.note: Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('hot').

examples.trans: Careful, the cup is very hot.

examples.text: Аркаша, держи горячий чай. И бутерброд с вареньем ешь.
examples.trans: Arkasha, here's some hot tea. And eat a jam sandwich.

meanings.note: Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('other, another, different').

examples.text: Послушайте, а можно в другое место? Здесь плохо пахнет.
examples.trans: Listen, could we go somewhere else? It smells bad in here.

examples.text: Спасибо вам за заботу, Анна Ивановна!
examples.trans: Thank you for your care, Anna Ivanovna!

examples.text: Дети требуют много терпения и настоящей заботы.
examples.trans: Children demand much patience and real care.

examples.text: Спасибо вам за понимание и заботу.
examples.trans: Thank you for your understanding and care.

meanings.note: emphasis: вот поэтому ты и... = that's exactly why you...

examples.trans: I was born and grew up here.

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

examples.text: Напиши: трус не играет в хоккей.
examples.trans: Write: a coward doesn't play hockey.
The children are playing in the courtyard.

examples.text: Хорошая фотография! Напиши: трус не играет в хоккей.
examples.trans: Good photo! Write: a coward doesn't play hockey.

meanings.note: Common feminine noun meaning 'toy' in everyday Russian.

examples.trans: Mum bought her son a toy.

examples.text: А во-вторых, я тебе могу игрушку купить, а твоя мама нет.
examples.trans: And second, I can buy you a toy, and your mum can't.

meanings.note: to run for a second term

examples.trans: He is running for a second term.

examples.text: Я очень люблю наш город. Поэтому я иду на второй срок.
examples.trans: I love our town very much. That's why I'm running for a second term.

examples.text: Конечно, помогу. Кто у вас сейчас начальник?
examples.trans: Of course I'll help. Who's your boss now?

meanings.note: Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('beautiful, handsome').

examples.trans: They have a very beautiful house.
Three rooms and a big kitchen.
And the kitchen is over there.

meanings.note: used when speaking to or about children

examples.trans: Eat well so that you grow up strong.
There, that is much better, eat up!

examples.text: Настя, почему ты не кушаешь мясо?
examples.trans: Nastya, why do you not eat meat?

meanings.note: лучший в мире = the best in the world

examples.text: Ты мне даёшь пятьсот рублей, а я выхожу и покупаю тебе лучшую приставку в мире.
examples.trans: You give me five hundred roubles, and I get out and buy you the best console in the world.

meanings.note: Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to love, to like', paired with 'полюбить'.

examples.trans: I love our town very much.

examples.text: Я очень люблю наш город. Поэтому я иду на второй срок.
examples.trans: I love our town very much. That's why I'm running for a second term.

meanings.note: в любой момент = at any moment

examples.text: Любая обезьяна эти выборы выиграет! Ты что, хуже обезьяны?
examples.trans: Any monkey will win this election! What, are you worse than a monkey?

meanings.note: used to address a child you don't know

examples.trans: And this is for you. A toy car!

meanings.en: to be in the way, to hinder

examples.trans: The radiators are in the way.

examples.text: Филиппыч, миксер проехать не может. Радиаторы мешают.
examples.trans: Filippych, the mixer truck can't get through. The radiators are in the way.
Can I go and have a look?

meanings.note: praise, said to a man, woman or child

examples.trans: I see, I see, you're a hero. Well done.

meanings.en: to grow, to grow up, to develop
meanings.note: Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to grow, to grow up', paired with 'вырасти'.

examples.text: Вообще надо расти во всех смыслах.
examples.trans: In general, I need to grow in every sense.

examples.text: Сегодня на кухне сварили вкусный суп.
examples.trans: Today in the kitchen they cooked delicious soup.
I cooked a special purée soup.

examples.text: А вы решили сварить мужу борщ?
examples.trans: And did you decide to make your husband borscht?

examples.text: Виктор Степанович, сегодня никак не могу.
examples.trans: Viktor Stepanovich, I really can't today.

meanings.en: strong, powerful (also used as a noun: the strong)
meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'ильный'). Adjective formed with the common Slavic suffix '-н-' from a noun/verb root. Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('strong, powerful').

examples.text: Сильный ищет способ, а слабый ищет причину.
examples.trans: The strong man looks for a way, and the weak man looks for an excuse.
A strong wind was blowing outside.

examples.text: Надо заманить его на свою территорию. Там, где ты сильный.
examples.trans: You need to lure him onto your territory. Right where you are strong.

meanings.note: спасибо за + accusative = thank you for

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'покойно'). Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

examples.text: Его не будет часа два. Вы спокойно всё сделаете.
examples.trans: He'll be gone for about two hours. You'll do everything calmly.

examples.text: Сегодня на кухне сварили вкусный суп.
examples.trans: Today in the kitchen they cooked delicious soup.
I like hot soup very much!

examples.text: Мы добавим таблетку в её суп?
examples.trans: Shall we add the pill into her soup?

meanings.note: at the start of a question

examples.trans: So I shouldn't wait for you?
So I shouldn't wait for you tonight?

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)

examples.trans: Dad, did you bring any gum?

meanings.note: after 'в' / 'на' the place form is 'углу' (stressed on the end): 'в углу' = in the corner

examples.trans: The café is on the corner.
Why are you sitting in the corner?

meanings.note: impersonal, + genitive: денег не хватило = there wasn't enough money

examples.trans: Gum? I didn't have enough money.

examples.text: Хватит хулиганить и мешать другим детям.
examples.trans: Stop misbehaving and bothering the other children.

examples.text: Это слово «хулиганить» часто звучит в разговоре.
examples.trans: This word 'to misbehave' is often heard in conversation.
I'm calling to say thank you.
So that there are witnesses, Samson.

meanings.note: alone: 'я этого не хочу' = I don't want that

examples.trans: I'm sick of this communal flat.

examples.text: Меня уже тошнит от этой коммуналки! У нас труба уже неделю течёт.
examples.trans: I'm sick of this communal flat! Our pipe has been leaking for a week now.

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)
